rationale: Saudi pipeline closure after Iraq drone attack threatens oil supply stability; Houthis seize strategic Red Sea island affecting US shipping interests.

top_events.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
top_events.label: Saudi pipeline shut after Iraq drone strike
top_events.summary: Saudi Arabia closed a major oil pipeline following a drone attack launched from Iraq near the Iranian border, raising concerns about oil supply stability and US energy markets.

top_events.title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
top_events.label: Houthis seize strategic island near Red Sea
top_events.summary: Iran-backed Houthis reportedly seized Perim island on a major shipping route, tightening control over Red Sea lanes critical to US commercial shipping.

top_events.title: Rubio signals shift to working with allies to fight drug trade as latest boat strike kills three
top_events.label: Rubio shifts to allied drug war cooperation
top_events.summary: Secretary of State Rubio visited Ecuador and signaled a shift toward working with allies to combat drug trafficking, moving away from unilateral strikes.

short_summary: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening US shipping

most_significant_event.label: Houthis seize Mokha port threatening US shipping
most_significant_event.summary: Mokha capture brings Houthis closer to controlling Bab al-Mandab Strait, a key waterway for US military logistics and commercial shipping routes.
most_significant_event.title: Yemen's Houthis reportedly seize strategic Red Sea port of Mokha
